invariants.rule: Exactly one authoritative SOMA host may own a canonical data instance at a time.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Concurrent or repeated launch cannot produce two writers or control an unrelated process.

invariants.rule: Beta 1.0 authoritative service exposure is loopback-only and never binds a wildcard, LAN, WAN, or cloud-facing origin.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Wildcard/non-loopback bind attempts fail before authoritative readiness.

invariants.rule: The browser is a replaceable presentation client; closing or restarting it does not define SOMA application lifetime or authoritative state.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Close/reopen browser while host remains running and verify state/jobs continue correctly.

invariants.rule: Every authoritative mutation reaches an owning domain policy through the local application boundary and the shared transaction/persistence rules.
invariants.acceptance_hook: No UI, adapter, scheduler, or helper path can mutate authoritative state by bypassing application/domain validation.

invariants.rule: Source adapters produce observations/staging/proposals before accepted mutation; source parsing is not an alternate write authority.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Malformed, rejected, or preview-only source processing leaves domain state unchanged.

invariants.rule: SQLite remains the sole authoritative Beta 1.0 operational datastore; caches, registries, diagnostics, projections, and client state are non-authoritative.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Rebuild/remove non-authoritative state without losing canonical domain truth.

invariants.rule: The installed operator runtime requires Python 3.13 or 3.14 on supported 64-bit Windows 10/11 and does not require Node.js.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Supported clean-install/start flows pass without installed Node.js.

invariants.rule: Runtime assets and product operation are local; Beta 1.0 requires no internet/CDN/cloud dependency to render or operate the application.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Representative full operator workflows run with external network connectivity unavailable.

invariants.rule: Startup does not expose authoritative operation until data ownership, configuration, migration, integrity, and readiness checks succeed.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Inject bootstrap/migration/integrity failures and verify no authoritative service becomes ready.

invariants.rule: Shutdown targets only the freshly revalidated current SOMA run, drains or rolls back authoritative work safely, and retires stale runtime identity.
invariants.acceptance_hook: PID/port reuse, forged/stale registry, and repeated Stop operations cannot terminate or trust an unrelated process.

invariants.rule: A second authoritative worker/service is not part of Beta 1.0 topology; background work is supervised by the host and uses durable checkpoints/application-service commands.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Long-running jobs remain restart-safe without an independent authoritative worker database or service.

invariants.rule: No frontend framework, dependency, process, or technical cache may redefine domain identities, lifecycles, relationships, or ownership boundaries.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Domain tests execute independently of browser implementation and produce the same accepted behavior.

invariants.rule: Beta repository/runtime lineage remains independent from Alpha/Zeus; Alpha migrations or schemas are never executable runtime prerequisites.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Clean Beta installation initializes solely from Beta migration/release lineage.

invariants.rule: Operational/customer/runtime/persistence/communication/diagnostic/backup/export material never becomes source-controlled product content.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Repository and release verification detects prohibited runtime/customer artifacts.
